title: Financial Assistance Policy, Section 11 — Reconsideration, Reapplication and Withdrawal
content:
**11.1 Reconsideration window.** Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), a denied case is reopened for reconsideration only when the patient supplies new information within the reconsideration period counted from the denial letter date. Count calendar days starting the day after the determination date; a request on the last day of the reconsideration period itself is accepted. The anchor is the determination date recorded on the case.

**11.2** A reconsideration also requires that at least one of the patient's open encounters is still inside its application period.

**11.3 Reapplication.** After a denial for the reason "income above limit", a fresh application without a documented change in household size or income is accepted only after the reapplication wait days.

**11.4 Withdrawal.** Only the patient can withdraw an application; a representative never withdraws one on the patient's behalf, and a withdrawn case cannot be reopened (a new application is filed instead).

### Boundary of 11.1 (hypothetical, reconsideration period of 30 days)

| New information supplied on | Reopened? |
|---|---|
| the 30th calendar day after the denial letter date | yes, if an open encounter is still inside its application period |
| the 31st calendar day after the denial letter date | no |

### Conditions together

| New information inside the reconsideration period | An open encounter inside its application period | Reconsideration |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | opened |
| yes | no | not opened |
| no | yes | not opened |
